value.agent-plugins-1-0-in-vs-code-copilot-cli: GitHub released Agent Plugins 1.0, a stable API for extending Copilot's agentic capabilities across VS Code, CLI, and web app, enabling custom automation workflows.
value.the-new-github-copilot-experience-in-sla: GitHub Copilot's redesigned Slack integration now allows teams to interact with Copilot agents and receive development assistance directly, lowering AI-assisted development barriers.
value.shared-agentic-work-with-github-copilot-: GitHub Copilot now supports shared agentic work in Microsoft Teams, enabling multiple team members to collaborate on AI-driven tasks, making AI assistance a team sport.
value.copilot-memory-and-ollama-in-github-copi: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now features persistent memory for cross-session context retention and Ollama support, enabling local model execution alongside cloud-based Copilot.
value.github-enterprise-server-3-22-release-ca: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is available as a release candidate, offering new features and improvements for self-hosted deployments, implying upcoming Copilot and security enhancements.
value.grok-4-6-is-now-available-in-github-copi: xAI's Grok 4.6 model is now available in GitHub Copilot, expanding the lineup and offering developers more choices for AI assistance tasks.
value.gemini-3-7-flash-is-now-available-in-git: Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash model is now accessible in GitHub Copilot, providing a fast, capable option for AI code assistance, attractive for latency-sensitive tasks.
value.mai-code-1-1-flash-available-in-github-c: Microsoft's MAI-Code-1.1-Flash model is now available in GitHub Copilot, providing an updated AI code model and a transition path as its predecessor deprecates.
value.codeql-2-26-3-improves-github-actions-qu: CodeQL 2.26.3 improves security analysis queries for GitHub Actions workflows and JavaScript/TypeScript data flow modeling, enhancing supply-chain security by catching vulnerabilities earlier.
value.credential-revocation-and-deauthorizatio: GitHub now allows credential revocation and OAuth app deauthorization by token type, providing finer-grained access control and reducing blast radius upon credential compromise.
